headline: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over child sexual abuse images created by Grok
summary: Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX Super Intelligence Corp, led by Elon Musk, alleging the company benefited from a Grok AI feature that generates child sexual abuse material and without safeguards.
why: SpaceX is a privately held aerospace and technology company led by Elon Musk, and state lawsuits over AI products raise regulatory and legal risks for the company.
original_headline: Virginia y Oregón demandan a SpaceX por imágenes de abuso sexual infantil creadas por Grok
